services.name: Private Dolphin Swim & Snorkeling Tour
services.desc: Witness incredible Florida ocean life up close and personal! About To start our tours, we ask that you arrive 15-20 minutes before the scheduled time of your tour to ensure we can give your group the full amount of time booked. With normal circumstances, this is how most of our tours are laid out: unless requested otherwise, we will take about a 15-minute ride out to the Gulf of Mexico, to the beautiful crystal clear emerald waters off the coast. Most of our dolphin encounters will happen in this area due to the abundance of bait and the clarity of the water. services.name: Private Sunset Tour
services.desc: See a beautiful sunset over the ocean, unlike any you've ever seen! About Our Sunset Tour is a great opportunity to have one of the best possible views available for what many would agree is one of the most spectacular sunsets in the world. On our Sunset Tour, you will still have the chance to get up close views of dolphins and visit Shell Island. On our tours you are able to bring small coolers with food and drinks, however please avoid bringing glass onboard.
